channel.title: Blow Your Mind
channel.desc: Dr Chris and Dr Xand van Tulleken bring you the top experts on the planet to show you things that will blow your mind. In this episode they find out what cats get up to when we aren't around. We go undercover to follow cats who have amazing GPS systems fitted, and watch what they get up to when we look through specially designed cat cameras.
